scope: Bound retained command-list storage by explicit Scene-range and layer-branch ownership; remove temporary compilation roots, flat-only detached fragments, root-tail bookkeeping and duplicate command-location types.
test_policy: Release, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1, --test-threads=1; ignored GPU tests included with explicit Metal registry ID and API validation.
review: Pristine regressions fail nested removal at iteration 0, Mask kind cycling at iteration 1, and offscreen reparenting at iteration 1. Non-tail root command removal is a passing edge contract.
Published Scene commands now own complete source-list ranges; current chunks and location maps are not used to infer retired storage. Layer branches recursively own their retained children.
One coalescing free-range allocator replaces flat-only exact-size holes and root-tail range bookkeeping. Live list indices never move; old Rc<Canvas> snapshots stay immutable.
Compilation reads a command slice directly with the original ancestor clip stack; all three temporary-root list paths are removed.

Old subtree ownership is released without deleting current node locations: multi-fragment hierarchy swaps can already have published a moved node at its new location. Six CPU and three allocator cases cover ownership, recycled source internals, snapshots, adjacent holes and stable indices.
Two Metal regression tests perform 99 fresh-renderer comparisons across both mask branches, internal clips/filters/masks and Mask kind cycling, with independent blue background pixels.
Full single-thread release suite passes 1205 cases in 44 binaries; no failures or ignored tests. Full rendering outputs remain byte-exact; final new-test lint diagnostics removed.
Historical glass/turbulence notes now link the verified Phase48 resolution and distinguish their original failed run from current checks.

protocol.application: 1280x800, 32 filtered chart cards, 25 draws per card; cycle one nested filtered tooltip through all 32 cards; one long-lived RetainedScene and NativeRenderer per observation
protocol.timing: render_retained through wait; transaction and PNG readback excluded; API validation disabled for timing, enabled for separate correctness runs
protocol.schedule: per pair compare then control, reverse block and label order on odd pairs; fixed stopping count

separate_process_measurement.interpretation: Paired process observations; descriptive bootstrap interval of median paired percentage changes. No samples discarded and fixed stopping count. GPU correctness uses separate validation-enabled runs. The application uses the default adapter on a host with one Metal GPU (Apple M5); GPU regression tests explicitly pin its registry ID.

protocol.counterbalance: rotate label order by observation mod 4; reverse order every pair of insertion/removal frames, independent of edit kind
protocol.reason: Completed separate-process comparison has wide uncertainty; identical-current controls vary similarly. Preserve all original results and run a predeclared matched-frame follow-up.
protocol.baseline_change: only Cargo package name is tileink_baseline to allow both revisions in one binary

performance_interpretation: Original 80 process observations are inconclusive because identical-current controls fluctuate similarly. The 20-process matched-frame follow-up reduces time separation; primary paired change -0.583%, identical-current -0.643%. Descriptive control-adjusted whole-frame median -0.035%, 95% interval [-1.062%, +1.015%]. No attributable speedup or material regression is resolved at that precision; smaller effects remain possible. Storage lifetime is fixed by ownership, not inferred from timing. All 327680 measured frame samples across both schedules are retained.
limits: Metal execution and measurements use the sole Apple M5 adapter. Windows checks are Rust type checks, not DX12/Vulkan driver execution.

The matched-frame baseline changes only the temporary Cargo package name; its Rust implementation is from the clean baseline commit. Both revisions use the same application body, dependency lock versions and GPU shader sources.
All measurement sources and executables are removed. Website changes are Markdown; dependencies are unavailable for a website build.

data_validation.website_build: not run; node_modules unavailable; Markdown docs only
